scope: Disposable native PostgreSQL, independent backend connections

checks.name: ordinary user cannot claim a publication
closed local publishing gate prevents claims
eight overlapping enqueue attempts create exactly one job for one approved revision
two workers claim distinct rows while both transactions overlap; third gets no duplicate
stale lease cannot finish; a successful requeue invalidates the old lease
expired lease becomes uncertain and is not automatically claimed again
worker skips an editing post, claims another due post and lets the editor cancel its queued revision
two overlapping workers reconcile expired leases without waiting or dispatching them again
an orphaned queued job is cancelled without dispatch
eight overlapping OAuth takes consume one state exactly once
overlapping duplicate payment events grant one credit-ledger entry
overlapping identical refund notifications reverse credits only once
overlapping distinct partial refunds reconcile exactly the full amount
24 overlapping AI quota requests allow exactly 20 free attempts
24 overlapping Storage metadata inserts preserve the 20-object owner quota

limitations: Auth and Storage catalogs are modeled. Actual provider APIs, hosted worker execution and email delivery are not tested.
listener: Private Unix socket only; TCP disabled
